examples.en: Every weekend I spend time out in nature.

examples.ko: 자연 보호를 위해 이 산에서는 캠핑을 못 해요.
examples.en: To protect nature, you can't camp on this mountain.

examples.ko: 저는 도시보다 자연이 좋아서 시골로 이사했어요.
examples.en: I like nature more than the city, so I moved to the countryside.
I teach children to love nature.
I made soap with ingredients from nature.

explain: '환경'은 사람을 둘러싼 조건 전체이고, '자연'은 산, 바다, 숲처럼 사람이 만들지 않은 것을 말해요. '자연 환경', '자연 보호'처럼 다른 말 앞에 붙여 많이 써요. 형용사 '자연스럽다'와 함께 알아 두세요.
explain_en: '환경' is the whole set of conditions around people, while '자연' means things not made by people, like mountains, seas and forests. It is often attached before other words, as in '자연 환경' and '자연 보호'. Also learn the adjective '자연스럽다' (natural).

examples.ko: 새 동네의 길이 차츰 익숙해져 가요.
examples.en: I'm gradually getting to know the streets of my new neighborhood.

examples.ko: 약을 먹고 나서 열이 차츰 내렸어요.
examples.en: After I took the medicine, my fever gradually went down.
When spring came, the weather gradually got warm.

examples.ko: 차츰 나아질 테니까 너무 걱정하지 마세요.
examples.en: It will get better little by little, so don't worry too much.

examples.ko: 처음엔 어색했지만 반 친구들과 차츰 친해졌어요.
examples.en: At first it was awkward, but I gradually became close with my classmates.

explain: ‘점점’과 뜻이 비슷하지만, ‘차츰’은 한 단계씩 천천히 가는 느낌이에요.
